name: usda-mcp-server
description: Search foods, compare nutrients, and look up the full USDA FoodData Central database via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

USDA_FDC_API_KEY.title: USDA FDC API Key
USDA_FDC_API_KEY.description: API key for the USDA FoodData Central API. Get one free at https://api.data.gov/signup/

USDA_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp request limits
USDA_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: true: an over-limit request is served up to its cap with a notice. usda_get_foods fetches the first 20 distinct FDC IDs and usda_compare_foods compares the first 5, returning the rest as deferredIds; usda_search_foods serves a pageSize above 200 at 200. false: more than 20 usda_get_foods entries, more than 5 usda_compare_foods entries, or a pageSize above 200 is rejected.
